Greesh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 12 December, 2024
Author: Manju Rani Chauhan

Bench: Manju Rani Chauhan
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:195982
Court No. - 52
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 11937 of 2024
Applicant :- Greesh

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Amit Rai,Avesh Pratap Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Deepak Kumar,G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Manju Rani Chauhan,J.
1.

Heard Mr. Amit Rai, learned counsel for the applicant, Mr. Deepak Kumar, learned counsel for
opposite party no.2 and Mr. Rizwan Ahmad, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the records.

2. This application u/s 482 has been filed by the applicant with the prayer to quash the entire
proceedings of Case No.2161 of 2017 (State Vs. Greesh) arising out of Case Crime No.72 of 2017,
under Sections 498A, 323, 504 Ipc and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Islam Nagar, District Budaun, on
the basis of compromise.

3. On 24.04.2024 the following order was passed in the matter:-
Greesh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 12 December, 2024

Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/119756399/
1

"1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Abhiuday Triapthi, Advocate holding
brief of Sri Deepak Kumar, learned counsel for opposite party no. 2 and learned Aga
for the State.

2.  This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant for quashing the entire proceedings of Case No.2161 of 2017 (State Vs. Greesh) arising out of Case Crime No.72 of 2017, under Sections 498A, 323, 504 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Islam Nagar, District Budaun against applicant on the basis of compromise dated 6.2.2024 which was taken place between the first informant and applicant and filed before the court of learned court concerned on 6.2.2024 and all consequential proceedings thereon.
3. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the parties have entered into a compromise.
4. Learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 also submits that parties have settled their dispute and he would have no objection in case the present criminal proceedings are quashed.
5. Learned A.G.A. submits that the compromise effected between the parties may be verified before the court concerned.

6. In the interest of justice, the applicant and the opposite party no.2 are directed to appear before the court concerned on 8.5.2024 and shall submit the compromise,
which shall be verified by the court concerned and a report in this regard shall be submitted before this Court within 15 days thereafter.

7. List on 1.7.2024 in top ten cases.
8.
Till the next date of listing, further proceedings in the aforesaid case shall remain stayed."

4. In compliance of the aforesaid order a report from Civil Judge Junior Division/ Fast Track Court (Crime Against Women), Budaun, has been placed on record alongwith compromise verification order dated 16.05.2024 vide which compromise entered between the parties has been verified.

5. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that since the compromise entered between the parties has been verified by the court below, the entire proceedings of the aforesaid criminal case may be quashed by this Court.

6. Learned counsel for opposite party no.2 and learned A.G.A. for the State also accept that the parties have entered into a compromise and the copy of the same has also been enclosed along with verification order, they have no objection, if the proceedings in the aforesaid case are quashed.

sentences.text: Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, as noted herein above, and also the submissions made by the counsel for the parties, the court is of the considered opinion that no useful purpose shall be served by prolonging the proceedings of the above mentioned criminal case as the parties have already settled their dispute.

10. Accordingly, the proceedings of entire proceedings of Case No.2161 of 2017 (State Vs. Greesh)
arising out of Case Crime No.72 of 2017, under Sections 498A, 323, 504 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P.
Act, P.S. Islam Nagar, District Budaun, pending before the court of Civil Judge (Junior Division)
F.T.C/ C.A.W./ Judicial Magistrate, Budaun on the basis of compromise, are hereby quashed.
